QuestInfo.name: [Luna Crystal] Invitation to the Butterfly Garden
QuestInfo.0: Wisp wants to talk to you while you're on a walk with the Lil Glowy Butterfly Pets. What do you suppose it's about?
QuestInfo.1:
Equip all 3 Lil Glowy Butterfly Pets, then return to Wisp.
You must equip the #rLil Luna Pets born from the Luna Crystal#k before you go.

#b#e[Lil Glowy Butterfly Set]#k#n\r\n#e[Pet]#n#i5002197#   #t5002197##i5002198#   #t5002198#\r\n#e#n#i5002199#   #t5002199#
QuestInfo.2: You brought all of the Lil Glowy Butterflies and got a gift from Wisp.

0.0: Hello, traveler! Is that the faint scent of flowers I smell?\r\n
0.1: Traveler, I believe the scent's coming from you! Could... Could it be...?\r\n
0.2: Could it be... the Glowy Butterflies, the ones they say appear late at night in the butterfly garden? I scarcely imagined such graceful and elegant creatures could exist. But now, thanks to you, #b#h0##k, here they are, before my very eyes.\r\n
0.3:
Seeing these elegant creatures positively fills me with happiness. #b#h0##k, if you happen to bring me the full
#e#bLil Glowy Butterfly Set#k#n, I'll be happy to reward you handsomely!
To be precise, I'll invite you to a more fitting place for the Glowy Butterflies. What do you say?
#r(You can only participate in this event once per world.)#k
#i3801570#

yes.0:
Oh, I knew I could count on you! This is so wonderful! Now, what I'd like you to do is #bequip all 3 of the Lil Glowy Butterflies#k, born from the Luna Crystal. Do that, and the reward is all yours!

no.0: That's a shame, but I suppose I must accept it... If only I could see those three Lil Glowy Butterflies all together...

1.0: Wow! So these are the famous Lil Glowy Butterfly children? How elegant! What a wonderful experience, to finally meet them!
1.1: Of course, I'd be remiss if I failed to show my appreciation. Ah... I've prepared a habitat, perfect for the elegance of the Lil Glowy Butterfly children. Will you accept it?

yes.0: Here, let me give you this #b#t3018609##k! It's a #bspecial chair you can sit on with the Petite Luna pets#k. Not only that, you can #bcommand the Petite Luna pets and feed them while you're sitting!#k Keep taking care of the Glowy Butterfly children!#k\r\n
